1.name: Monday: Push (Chest/Shoulders/Triceps)
1.cardio: Treadmill: 20 min | 5% incl. | 4.2 - 4.8 km/h (2.6 - 3.0 mph) [Alts: Stair Climber Lvl 5-6 | Elliptical Res 6-7]

exercises.name: Flat Bench Press: 3x6-8
exercises.detail: Mandatory scapular retraction. Lower bar to lower chest level.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press: 3x8-10
exercises.detail: Bench set to 30-45 degrees. Deep stretch on upper chest.

exercises.name: Seated Military Press: 3x8-10
exercises.detail: Core tight, do not arch lower back. Full range of motion.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises: 3x12-15
exercises.detail: Lead with elbows slightly bent. Controlled tempo on descent.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown: 3x10-12
exercises.detail: Elbows pinned to ribs. Squeeze peak contraction for 1 sec.

2.name: Tuesday: Legs 1 (Quad Focus) + Abs
2.cardio: Treadmill: 20 min | 0% incl. | 4.0 km/h (2.5 mph) [Alts: Stair Climber Lvl 4 | Elliptical Res 5]

exercises.name: Barbell Squat or Hack Squat: 3x6-8
exercises.detail: Break parallel depth. Push firmly through full foot plant.

exercises.name: Leg Press: 3x10-12
exercises.detail: Feet low on platform. Do not lock knees at full extension.

exercises.name: Leg Extension: 3x12-15
exercises.detail: Controlled concentric, 1-second hold at peak contraction.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl: 3x10-12
exercises.detail: Hips glued to bench. 3-second controlled eccentric phase.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raises: 4x10-15
exercises.detail: Full stretch at bottom step, squeeze calves hard at top.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Crunch (Abs): 3x12-15
exercises.detail: Anchor feet securely on the decline board. Flex the spine (roll the torso), do not just hinge at the hips. Hold a weight plate across the chest if bodyweight is too easy.

3.name: Wednesday: Pull (Back/Biceps)
3.cardio: Treadmill: 20 min | 5% incl. | 4.2 - 4.8 km/h (2.6 - 3.0 mph) [Alts: Stair Climber Lvl 5-6 | Elliptical Res 6-7]

exercises.name: Pull-ups or Lat Pulldown: 3x6-8
exercises.detail: Depress scapulae before pulling. Touch upper chest to bar.

exercises.name: Barbell or Machine Row: 3x8-10
exercises.detail: Torso steady. Pull elbows close along ribs toward hip.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Cable Pullover: 2x12-15
exercises.detail: Slight elbow bend, feel deep lat stretch at top position.

exercises.name: Face Pulls: 3x12-15
exercises.detail: Pull toward forehead, flare rope ends apart. Target rear delts.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl: 3x10-12
exercises.detail: Elbows fixed at sides. Supinate wrist at peak contraction.

4.name: Thursday: Legs 2 (Hamstrings/Glutes) + Abs
4.cardio: Treadmill: 20 min | 0% incl. | 4.0 km/h (2.5 mph) [Alts: Stair Climber Lvl 4 | Elliptical Res 5]

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift: 3x8-10
exercises.detail: Hinge hips backward. Neutral spine, bar tracking close to shins.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat: 3x10-12
exercises.detail: Torso slightly leaned forward. Lower hips deep into movement.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl: 3x12-15
exercises.detail: Adjust thigh pad firmly. Squeeze hamstrings forcefully.

exercises.name: High-Foot Leg Press: 2x12-15
exercises.detail: Feet high and wide on platform. Drive knees toward chest.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raises: 4x10-15
exercises.detail: Strict eccentric control, pause 1 second in bottom stretch.

exercises.name: Flat Bench Lying Leg Raises (Abs): 3x12-15
exercises.detail: Lie on a flat bench, grab the bench behind your head. Keep legs slightly bent, focus on rolling the pelvis upward off the bench to engage the lower rectus abdominis.

5.name: Friday: Torso (Maintenance)
5.cardio: Treadmill: 20 min | 6% incl. | 4.5 km/h (2.8 mph) [Alts: Stair Climber Lvl 6 | Elliptical Res 7]

exercises.name: Cable Chest Flyes: 3x10-12
exercises.detail: Feel deep pectoral stretch, squeeze hands together at peak.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row: 3x8-10
exercises.detail: Pull dumbbell directly toward hip pocket, not upper chest.

exercises.name: Machine Overhead Press: 3x10-12
exercises.detail: Constant tension. Do not let weight stack touch bottom.

exercises.name: Cable Biceps Curl: 2x12-15
exercises.detail: Constant cable tension. Hold peak squeeze for 1 second.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension: 2x12-15
exercises.detail: Elbows pointing up and tucked close. Extend fully overhead.

6.name: Saturday: Mountain Biking (MTB)
6.cardio: Duration: 90-120 min | HR Zones: 2 to 4 [Alts: Steady-state Elliptical 60 min]

0.name: Sunday: Recovery Cycling
0.cardio: Duration: 45-60 min | HR Zones: 1 and 2 strict [Alts: Low-resistance Regenerative Elliptical]
